propositions: Add CLI flag `rebar review-plan --retry` that resumes only the latest INDETERMINATE review by reusing checkpointed findings from journal units marked success/resumed and re-running only failed/cancelled/shed units with a fresh per-invocation attempt budget.

Retry eligibility gate refuses (exit 2, stderr remedy) before any model call if latest result is not INDETERMINATE, journal is missing/stale/corrupt/legacy/digest-mismatched, or recomputed identity-digest set no longer matches current material/policy/prompts/contracts/model/mode/topology/context/dependencies/source.

Reuse content from CheckpointEnvelope for each eligible unit by recomputing its checkpoint_identity and loading via sizing.load_checkpoint; treat units with changed digest or missing envelope as retryable missing.

Budget-shed units are identified from budget_indeterminate findings in the payload (not journal), enumerated as missing, and re-attempted under fresh budget; verification/coaching and deterministic decision/assembly rerun only for newly recovered findings.
--retry is mutually exclusive with --force, --status, --check; compatible with --no-sign; has no MCP mirror or CI-provider dependency.

Document retry in canonical --help, docs/cli-reference.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, and docs/exit-codes.md covering eligibility, fresh budget, reuse/refusal behavior, flag conflicts, signing, and full-review remedy.
